data.title: Four stages, one closed refrigerant loop
data.body: 1. Outdoor coil absorbs latent heat from ambient air even at −15°C. 2. Compressor raises refrigerant pressure and temperature. 3. Indoor coil condenses the refrigerant, releasing heat into the home. 4. Expansion valve drops pressure; the cycle repeats.

data.title: Why COP beats nameplate efficiency
data.body: A gas boiler is capped at ~0.9 useful heat units per unit of fuel (less, after losses). A heat pump's Coefficient of Performance (COP) measures useful heat over electricity consumed — typically 2.5 to 4.5 across a heating season.
